title: Henkel's clutch threes and McDaniel's 21 off the bench seal Enovos League title for Etzella
description: Etzella Ettelbruck are the 2025-26 Enovos League champions, holding off a furious Sparta Bertrange rally 87-81 in Game 3 at the Centre sportif du Deich on Sunday to complete a 3-0 sweep of the best-of-five finals before 950 fans. It looked comfortable for 30 minutes. Then it looked like it was slipping away. Then Thomas Henkel (190-G-1993) buried two clutch three-pointers down the stretch that silenced Sparta's comeback and sent Ettelbruck into delirium.
imageCaption: Enovos League title for Etzella (Photo: instagram)

title: Etzella sweep T71 to clinch their 16th LBBL title
description: Etzella - T71 87-80 T71 was trailing by 1 point at halftime but managed to get 1-point lead after three quarters before a 29-21 charge of Etzella, which allowed them to win the game. They made 21-of-27 free shots (77.8 percent) during the game. The game was dominated by American players. The best player for the winners was power forward Quatarrius Wilson (203-1996, college: SEMO, agency: One Motive Sports) who had a double-double by scoring 33 points (!!!) and 15 rebounds. Guard Jimmie Taylor (193-1994, college: Rider) chipped in 28 points. Taylor is a former Eurobasket Summer League player, which is considered top international summer league in the market. At the other side the best for losing team was forward Eddie Colbert III (198, college: Charleston) who recorded a double-double by scoring 27 points and 10 rebounds and guard Brandon Randolph (187-1995, college: Utah Valley) added…
imageCaption: Etzella sweep T71 to clinch their 16th LBBL title (Photo: rtl.lu)

title: Amicale are 23/24 LBBL champions
description: Etzella - Amicale 65-69 Amicale clinched LBBL title. They overcame Etzella on the road in Game 4 of the championship series to lift the trophy. Etzella trailed by 12 points after 3 quarters before a 19-11 run in the last quarter cut the deficit to 65-69 at the end of the game. Worth to mention a great performance of American forward Kim Aiken Jr (201-1999, college: NM State) who helped to win the game recording a double-double by scoring 20 points and 13 rebounds. The former international guard Bob Melcher (189-1994) contributed with 15 points for the winners. Four Amicale players scored in double figures. American guard Jimmie Taylor (193-1994, college: Rider) replied with 23 points, 9 rebounds and 4 assists and the former international point guard Philippe Gutenkauf (183-1995) added 18 points and 4 assists in the effort for Etzella.
imageCaption: Amicale are 23/24 LBBL champions

title: LBBL Round 4 of Finals. Basket Esch celebrate the title
description: Esch - Amicale 82-71 Basket Esch clinched the Total League title. They overcame Amicale at home court in Game 4 to win the championship series 3-1. The game without a history. Esch led from the first minutes and controlled entire game increasing their lead in each quarter. Worth to mention a great performance of American swingman Jordan Hicks (201-1990, college: Loyola, IL) who helped to win the game recording 23 points and 9 rebounds. The former international power forward Clancy Rugg (204-1991, college: Vermont) contributed with 19 points and 7 rebounds for the winners. American swingman Jarvis Williams (198-1989, college: MSU, agency: BIG) replied with a double-double by scoring 24 points and 13 rebounds and his fellow American import forward Alex Reese (206-1999, college: Alabama, agency: Interperformances) added 19 points and 15 rebounds in the effort for Amicale. Both coaches used…
imageCaption: LBBL Round 4 of Finals. Basket Esch celebrate the title (Photo: rtl.lu)

title: Amicale conquer LBBL title
description: Amicale - T71 87-68 Amicale conquered LBBL title. They beat T71 in the decisive fifth game of the championship series to lift the trophy. Amicale outrebounded T71 42-31 including 32 on the defensive glass. Swingman Jarvis Williams (198-1989, college: MSU) orchestrated the victory with a double-double by scoring 37 points (!!!) and 14 rebounds. The former international guard Bob Melcher (189-1994) contributed with a double-double by scoring 23 points, 11 rebounds and 6 assists for the winners. International point guard Kevin Moura (182-1994) answered with 21 points and 8 rebounds and American guard Jimmie Taylor (193-1994, college: Rider) added 21 points in the effort for T71. Four T71 players scored in double figures.
imageCaption: Amicale conquer LBBL title (Photo: Facebook/AmicaleSteesel)

title: T71 Dudelange crowned Total League champions
description: Esch - T71 71-82 T71 Dudelange have been crowned Total League champions. They defeated Esch on the road in Game 2 to complete the sweep of the Finals. The game was mostly controlled by T71. Esch managed to win fourth quarter 21-19. But it was not enough to take a lead and get a victory that evening. American guard Jimond Ivey (196-96, college: Akron) orchestrated the victory by scoring 23 points and 6 assists. The other American import forward Steve Harris (201-95, college: ESU) contributed with a double-double by scoring 18 points and 10 rebounds for the winners. Four T71 players scored in double figures. International power forward Clancy Rugg (204-91, college: Vermont) replied with a double-double by scoring 27 points and 11 rebounds and American guard Miles Cartwright (190-92, college: Pennsylvania) added 11 points, 6 rebounds and 4 assists in the effort for Esch.
imageCaption: T71 Dudelange crowned Total League champions (Photo: luxembourg.basketball)
